news.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are available through the API
news.summary: OpenAI documents the new Astra and Sol API identifiers, reasoning controls and standard token prices.
news.whyItMatters: The catalog can distinguish a balanced Sol route from the more expensive Astra route using published rates.
news.suggestedAction: Evaluate both on a small set of sanitized tasks before changing team defaults.

news.title: OpenAI adds healthcare model configurations to the Responses API
news.summary: OpenAI made healthcare-specific model configurations available to API organizations through the Responses API. One documented model ID is `gpt-6.2-astra-healthcare`. With web search enabled, the configurations can query a dedicated healthcare index and cite sources when summarizing medical evidence. An API organization can use them without a ChatGPT for Healthcare workspace.
news.whyItMatters: Teams building tools for healthcare clients can evaluate a dedicated evidence search option in their existing Responses API integration.
news.suggestedAction: Test citation coverage on public literature and confirm account and tool eligibility before using protected health information.
